orientation: Non-stationary relational history for the self-sourced field package

carrier.type: finite clock tensor finite complex field

candidate_move.description: Generate a non-eigenstate self-sourced field history with changing potentials and build the discrete relational constraint map whose kernel contains that history.

predictive_structural: A generated non-stationary self-sourced history can be encoded by a discrete relational constraint map on the toy carrier.
analytical_structural: The generated history has near-zero constraint residual while the wrong-generator control remains positive.
organizational_audit: History diagnostics, constraint singular values, residuals, readouts, and matrices are saved.
remaining_external_content: A less history-adapted nonlinear constraint and physical frame transfer remain external-review tasks.
